title: Salmon Burgers on Toast with Salad & Potatoes
originalTitle: Salmom burgers on toast with salad and potatoes
ingredients: 1.5 lbs fresh wild salmon or steelhead fillet, skinless, finely chopped
2 tbsp light mayonnaise or Greek yogurt
1 tbsp lemon juice + 1 tsp lemon zest
1/2 tsp kosher salt & 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper
4 slices thick-cut sourdough or brioche toast
4 cups mixed baby greens tossed with lemon-olive oil vinaigrette
1.5 lbs baby potatoes, halved and roasted at 400°F with olive oil, salt & rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss halved baby potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, and rosemary; roast cut-side down for 25–30 minutes until crisp.
Cut a quarter of the salmon into a fine paste with your knife (acts as the binder) and dice the remaining salmon into 1/4-inch pieces.
Fold the salmon together with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, dill, scallions, lemon juice, zest, panko, salt, and black pepper. Form into 4 patties.
Sear the salmon patties in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden crisp outside and 125–130°F internally.
Serve patties open-faced or sandwiched on toasted sourdough alongside the crisp herb-roasted potatoes and lemon-dressed green salad.
